I am a second-year PhD student at the Graduate School of Economics, The University of Tokyo, and a JSPS Research Fellow (DC2).

My primary research investigates the spatial evolution of markets, focusing on the historical case of German territories in the 19th century.

**Research Interests:** Economic History · Spatial Economics · Market Integration · Customs Unions · 19th Century Germany · Historical GIS · Simulation Modeling
